read.thesis: Nitrogen supply tightening as ~9 Mt urea lost since February and >35% of European ammonia curtailed; CF runs 97% utilisation and sees mid-cycle EBITDA rising to $3.3B by 2030.

utilisation.quote: we have operated our available ammonia capacity at 97% utilization

capex.peers_comment: Management said modular US ammonia announcements (50,000-150,000 tons) are too small to move the balance; European capacity is curtailed rather than added.
capex.quote: our 2026 consolidated capital expenditure outlook remains approximately $1.3 billion

triggers.label: European ammonia >35% curtailed
triggers.quote: We believe more than 35% of ammonia capacity in the region is curtailed.

triggers.label: Global urea supply lost ~9 Mt
triggers.quote: we estimate that the global market has lost approximately nine million metric tons of urea supply

triggers.label: NOLA ammonia ~$430/st for Q4
triggers.quote: today trading at $430 for Q4 for a short. That's on a short ton for NOLA.

triggers.label: Mid-cycle EBITDA $2.9B to $3.3B by 2030
triggers.quote: We expect these projects to add $400 million to our mid-cycle EBITDA estimate by 2030, bringing it to $3.3 billion.

triggers.label: European shutdowns may accelerate 12-18 months
triggers.quote: it is going to accelerate from what we thought was a 2030 timeframe with some of those European shutdowns to occur

guidance.quote: We expect these projects to add $400 million to our mid-cycle EBITDA estimate by 2030, bringing it to $3.3 billion.
our 2026 consolidated capital expenditure outlook remains approximately $1.3 billion
our current growth projects, combined with our existing share repurchase authorization, are expected to increase nitrogen per share by 15% by 2030.
The projected total cost remains $3.7 billion, with ammonia production expected to commence in 2029.

red_flags.label: Brazil urea imports down ~1 Mt on credit constraints
red_flags.quote: Brazil has been slower to purchase, in part because of credit constraints.

red_flags.label: Chinese export quotas on ammonium sulfate
red_flags.quote: they are starting to put quotas on ammonium sulfate exports

evasions.topic: Quarter-over-quarter insurance and Yazoo cash timing
evasions.quote: We're not trying to give guidance on what it's going to look like quarter over quarter
